answer: The inlet register is checked at draw time, atlas lists the eligible set, and opal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Each impostor pays 5 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
